what is it

A puzzle game I made for a game jam. The mechanic is about casting shadows — you move a light source around to reveal hidden paths.

Built in Godot over a weekend.

what i learned

  • Godot's 2D lighting system is more flexible than I expected
  • Scope is everything in a jam
